ValidationRule.description: This Ensures 'Reference Number' is mandatory and numeric-only when the Application Type is BBD and the Stage is Opportunity Won.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ApplicationForm.Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', $User.Profile_Name__c = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', ApplicationForm.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'BBD', ISPICKVAL(Stage, 'Opportunity Won'), OR( ISBLANK(Reference_Number__c), NOT(REGEX(Reference_Number__c, "^[0-9]{10}$")) ) )
